run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
run_WikiBrancher_BranchFiles: run WikiBrancher.BranchFiles to SVN copy wiki files with a version prefix for a new release
run_WikiBrancher_UpdateLinksInBranchedFi: run WikiBrancher.UpdateLinksInBranchedFiles to update internal wiki links in versioned branched files
run_WikiBrancher_GetFilesToBranch: run WikiBrancher.GetFilesToBranch to get a list of wiki files that need to be branched
run_DropWikiSuffix: run DropWikiSuffix to remove the .wiki suffix from a wiki filename
